/bin/bash -lc "rg \"FormRow\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -20; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/AvatarImage.d.ts; rg \"export declare const Option\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select -g '*.d.ts' -A3"
